name: Bizmasi — Cây tri thức nở hoa

representation.trunk: Upright fluted trunk, 11 buttress roots, six connected radial branches
representation.canopy: One balanced dome; curved oval leaves on shoots; ivory five-petal flowers
representation.rootGarden: Six loose woodland beds with limestone, moss, pebbles, ferns and wildflowers
representation.setting: Daylight meadow, surrounding hills, HDRI sky

labels.placement: Fixed 3D anchors on six radial branches
labels.visibility: Front-facing surface normal dot camera direction > 0.18, and fully within viewport

rendering.parkWhen: Motion paused, reduced motion enabled, tab hidden or scene offscreen
rendering.shadows: Cached static tree shadows; inexpensive squirrel contact shadows

deployment: Website source in GitHub; archives and crawl directories remain local

wildlife.roosts: Nine radial locations at multiple heights; natural canopy occlusion
wildlife.idle: Staggered branch-to-branch flights around the canopy
wildlife.squirrelGroups: Two close pairs facing each other, returning to camera-side feeding spots
wildlife.landing: Upright braking, feet extension, gradual wing fold and contact compression
